title: Bundled practice catalog
description: Repository-managed practice definitions installed into the curated instance catalog.

$schema.description: Schema used by editors and CI to validate this catalog.

criteriaPreambles.description: Shared review instructions keyed by reviewed work type or a named specialization.

groups.description: Ordered practice groups; array order is the bundled display order.

group.description: A named group of related practices.

slug.description: Stable group identifier used for provenance and URLs.

description.description: Optional explanation of the group's purpose.

icon.description: Optional icon name supported by the admin interface.

color.description: Optional color name supported by the admin interface.

practices.description: Ordered practices in this group; array order is the bundled display order.

slug.description: Stable practice identifier used for provenance, observations, and URLs.

signals.description: Signals that occasion this review. All must share one artifact kind; that kind is what the practice reviews.

evidenceRequirements.description: Sources a review occasioned this way reads. Omit to read the artifact kind's default evidence.

sourceKind.description: Stable source identifier from the shipped source contract.

stance.description: REQUIRED: the claim reads it. EXHAUSTIVE: the claim asserts something is absent from it, so a partial capture cannot satisfy it. CONTEXTUAL: used if present, never fatal.

subject.description: Whose conduct a review occasioned this way judges, and therefore which person its observations are filed against. Defaults to AUTHOR. A practice about reviewing somebody else's work names REVIEWER; one about the act of merging names MERGER, reviewed only when the merger is the author the run is about.

precondition.description: What must be in the work for this practice to have anything to judge. Decided from staged evidence before the practice is put to a model, so a practice whose prerequisite is provably absent is not asked. Omit to apply to every artifact of this kind.

precomputeScript.description: Optional classpath resource containing TypeScript that prepares structured review context.

preamble.description: Optional named criteria preamble; defaults to the reviewed work type.

criteria.description: Markdown guidance any reviewer reads: the standard, the sources and their limits, what to cite, and what other practices own. It never decides the outcome; the judgment does.

judgment.description: Yes/no questions the review answers from evidence, and ordered rules that decide the outcome from the answers. A practice Hephaestus never reviews keeps them for the person who answers them.

whyItMatters.description: Optional developer guidance explaining the value of the practice.

whatGoodLooksLike.description: Optional developer guidance giving a concrete positive example.

holdsAs.description: One present-tense sentence naming what the developer keeps doing when this practice holds, shown on the practice profile beside a practice that stands as a strength, written without dashes. Read from the bundled catalog by slug, never copied into a workspace.

deliveryBehavior.description: How negative feedback from this practice is placed or deduplicated.

insufficiencyReason.description: Present only when the evidence Hephaestus collects cannot support this practice's question: the practice ships as needing human review, Hephaestus never reviews it, and this says why. Such a practice carries no holdsAs: nothing it recorded can support one.

reviewWhen.description: Allowed categorical review states from the artifact descriptor. Values within a dimension are alternatives; every selected dimension must match. Omitted dimensions are unrestricted. Empty selections and unsupported dimensions or values are rejected.

deliveryBehavior.description: Declared feedback placement and co-occurrence choices for a practice.

summaryOnly.description: Show feedback in the summary instead of on a changed line.

overlapGroup.description: On issues, show only the first negative practice in this group.

redundantToSlug.description: When both practices are negative, show feedback from this preferred practice instead.

signalName.description: Vendor-neutral signal name, <domain>.<kind>.<signal>; its prefix is the artifact kind.

precondition.description: A mechanical review precondition: what has to be in a piece of work for a practice to have anything to judge about it, and the sentence to show a reader when it is not.

skipReason.description: Sentence shown wherever the resulting silence is explained, in the practice author's voice and phrased as a fact about the work, e.g. 'the change touches no dependency manifest or lockfile'.

anyOf.description: Alternative prerequisites. The precondition is satisfied when any one is found, and provably absent only when every one was decided and none was found, so adding a clause can only make the practice run more often.

preconditionClause.description: One prerequisite that can satisfy the precondition. Exactly one of the three properties is stated; a clause nothing could settle leaves the practice running.

changedPathMatches.description: Globs matched against every path the change names, both sides of a rename. '*' does not cross a '/', '**' does, and a leading '**/' also matches zero segments so '**/pom.xml' finds a root pom.xml. Every other character is literal.

diffContains.description: Literal strings sought anywhere in the diff — added, removed or context — so that removing the last test in a file still counts as the prerequisite being satisfied. Literals rather than patterns: the declaration is operator-editable and is scanned over every diff of every review.

evidenceHasItems.description: A named evidence collection that must hold at least one entry. An empty collection settles the clause only when its source was captured whole.

judgment.description: Questions a review answers and the rules that turn the answers into an outcome; the first matching rule decides, and every combination of answers reaches a rule.

questions.description: The yes/no questions a review answers, in the order it answers them.

rules.description: Ordered rules; the first whose conditions match the answers decides, and the last has no conditions.

question.description: One yes/no question, answerable on its own from the practice's sources.

key.description: Stable identifier rules and recorded answers refer to.

title.description: Short statement a YES affirms, without a final period.

question.description: The question as the reviewer reads it: what counts and what does not.

yes.description: What a YES means for the reviewed work.

no.description: What a NO means for the reviewed work.

rule.description: When every named question has the stated answer, this rule decides the outcome.

id.description: Stable identifier an observation records as the rule that decided it.

when.description: Question key to the answer it requires; {} matches every combination.

severity.description: How much a shortfall costs; present exactly when the outcome is NOT_MET.

reason.description: One sentence about the work: the observation's headline and its warrant.
